composition.reason: sinter compose --hybrid (spawned CLI, fake provider) runs the parts below end to end; per-part status in `parts`

CompositionEngine.used_by: src/composition/hybrid/HybridProject.ts buildHybridProject: holds every hybrid layer

LayerMask.used_by: HybridProject.ts: createMask + generateCSSMask for every mask layer

KeyframeAnimation.used_by: HybridProject.ts: generateCSS writes the beat grid (one loop per beat at plan.bpm)

CompositionAnalyzer.used_by: HybridProject.ts: keyword cross-check of the planner's domains; HybridComposition.ts judgeHybrid folds it into the named criterion 'seam/coherence between layers' (verdict + composition.hybrid.json judge.coherence)

adapters/*.used_by: HybridProject.ts: registerAllAdapters, adapter.validate per p5/three/shader/hydra/tone/strudel layer (loud, names the layer). html/ascii adapters are not run: they judge fragments, hybrid layers are full pages (HTMLAdapter.ts:317 rejects script tags)

LayerSequencer.used_by: src/composition/hybrid/HybridGeneration.ts generateHybridLayers: generateLayers makes every planned layer from its own prompt, one after another, through CompositionOrchestrator.generateGovernedLayer (generator registry, provider-call ledger, seam guard); compose() then assembles that code (vendor inlining, render gate). orderDomains stays in HybridProject.ts. Closes issue 1951.
LayerSequencer.does: Makes the layers of a layered piece one at a time, each from its own prompt, and stops at the first layer that fails.
LayerSequencer.effect: Same prompt, three layers, first layer broken: through the sequencer the fake provider was asked 2 times (the broken layer and its one retry) and the piece failed naming layer 0; bypassed, compose() asks all layers at once (Promise.all, CompositionOrchestrator.ts), so the later layers are paid for before the failure shows. Guard: test/integration/hybrid-compose-cli.test.ts fails if manifest composition.generation.via is not LayerSequencer.generateLayers.

CompositionControlRuntime.used_by: src/composition/hybrid/HybridControl.ts: the plan's beat signals compile to a ControlRecipe, validated by CompositionEngine.loadControlRecipe and rehearsed on CompositionControlRuntime (CompositionEngine.createControlRuntime) at build time; the page runs the recipe on ControlArtifact's embedded runtime (same logic, in-page) with postMessage bindings; the judge checks every mapping wrote its target
CompositionControlRuntime.note: the page cannot import the host class (self-contained html), so the embedded twin in ControlArtifact.ts runs there
CompositionControlRuntime.does: Turns the layers' shared beat into a validated control recipe that drives the overlay's scale while the page plays.
CompositionControlRuntime.effect: Same page, control script on vs stripped, now with a kinetic layer that reads the beat (glsl background + kinetic overlay, headless render): on, mapping beat-0 wrote its target (0.296) and the judge passed; stripped, the target was never written and the judge failed the piece ('the in-page control loop never wrote its target'). Whole-frame change over 3.5 s is about the same either way (0.070 on vs 0.066 off) because the stage keeps posting the beat to the layer itself; the pixel proof is per layer: holding the beat at 1 versus 0 moves the wired layer by 0.047 against 0.039 of its own motion, and a layer that ignores the beat (earlier fixture) fails the coherence check naming the layer. The earlier near-identical frames were a deaf fixture plus a bridge that let control values overwrite the beat; both fixed, and wired layers are now told to make the beat visible. Fake-provider fixture only: needs real seats to prove a real model obeys the brief.

The file is flagged because it constructs EvidenceConsolidationCoordinator, and IntuitionEngine (which builds it) is only reachable from legacy RalphLoop, which ALSO writes learned state (recordOutcome + save to ~/.sinter/intuition) and emits a hint that names a model ('model=X, strategy=Y'). Quarantine NOT bypassed.
